skills.name: Loadout
skills.description: Allows you to manage skills stolen from other Explorer characters. Use this skill to forget stolen skills or call them up with Impeccable Memory. Skills may be assigned to an Impeccable Memory slot of the same rank or higher. Skills cannot be used immediately after being assigned.

skills.name: Carte Noir
skills.description:
Each critical attack directly from Phantom has a chance to produce a card that attacks nearby enemies automatically. This card is added to your deck.
A Swerve Card is prepared periodically, and when direct skill attacks hit among the skills of Phantom, or an attack skill that utilizes Impeccable Memory hits successfully, additional attacks are made against nearby enemies who didn't get the skill attack. The Swerve Card doesn't add to the deck of cards, and is unaffected by attack reflection. Additionally, Avoidability is permanently increased.

skills.name: Luck of the Draw
skills.description: Throw a flurry of cards until you're down to your last one. Will luck be on your side as you unveil it? The cards will attack the boss monster in the area with highest max HP first. You are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill, and are invincible while you draw the card after the attack stops.

skills.name: Luck of the Draw

skills.name: Luck of the Draw

skills.name: Ace in the Hole
skills.description: Throw a razor-sharp card, infused with incredible power, that ricochets dangerously. The card will ricochet against nearby enemies several times, starting with the highest-Max-HP enemy among them. If there are no nearby enemies, the card's magic will trigger instantly. If the skill is used again when all of the throwable cards are present, the cards will gather around the enemy with the highest Max HP, from amongst enemies in front of Phantom, to release all their power at once. The released cards' attack activation count increases proportionally to the remaining attack count. If you use the skill with the down arrow key, you can release the power immediately after throwing a card. Ace in the Hole is not affected by attack reflection skills. Can be used without a casting animation during Tempest.
